user.title: Divoom Local
user.description: Which device are you adding? Everything stays on your network.

times_gate.title: Times Gate
times_gate.description: The LocalToken is shown in the Divoom app under the device's settings. Hardware revision 400 is the original model; 402 is the newer one.

reauth_confirm.title: New LocalToken
reauth_confirm.description: The Times Gate rejected its LocalToken, usually after re pairing in the Divoom app. Enter the current one.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the device at that address.
error.invalid_response: Something answered, but it did not look like that device.

abort.already_configured: This device is already set up.

send_command.name: Send command
send_command.description: Send a raw command object to a Divoom device and return its reply. For advanced use, such as custom layouts.

config_entry_id.name: Device
config_entry_id.description: The Divoom Local entry to send to.

payload.name: Payload
payload.description: Command object, for example {"Command": "Channel/GetClockInfo"}. Transport fields such as LocalToken are added automatically.
